mapper.update: UPDATE agent_action_logs SET undo_snapshot_json=#{snapshot} WHERE proposal_id=#{proposalId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND result='succeeded' AND undo_snapshot_json IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT proposal_id,kind,target_id,summary,result,executed_at,undo_snapshot_json,undone_at FROM agent_action_logs WHERE proposal_id=#{proposalId} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_action_logs SET result='undone',undone_at=#{undoneAt} WHERE proposal_id=#{proposalId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND result='succeeded' AND undo_snapshot_json IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT proposal_id,kind,target_id,summary,result,executed_at,undo_snapshot_json,undone_at FROM agent_action_logs WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY executed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_action_logs a JOIN agent_proposals p ON p.id=a.proposal_id AND p.user_id=a.user_id JOIN conversation_messages m ON m.id=p.source_message_id AND m.user_id=a.user_id SET a.summary='来源已删除', a.result='revoked' WHERE a.user_id=#{userId} AND m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND a.kind IN ('memory','followup','one_off_reminder')
